In Re: An application for bail under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal
 Procedure filed on 09.10.2023 in connection with Chanditala Police
 Station Case No.198 of 2020 dated 11.08.2020 under Sections
 498A/302/34 of the Indian Penal Code.

And
 In Re: Amit Das @ Khoka
 ... ... Petitioner
 Ms. Jeenia Rudra
 Ms. Megha Chanda
 ... ... for the petitioner
 Mr. Saswata Gopal Mukherji .. ld. Public Prosecutor
 Ms. Faria Hossain
 Mr. Anand Kesari
 ... ... for the State

1.
Heard the learned Advocates appearing for both the parties.
2. We have considered the materials on record.
Petitioner is the husband of the victim lady.
She had been strangulated at her matrimonial home.
Offences, if proved, would attract mandatory life imprisonment.
Bail prayer of the petitioner was rejected in March, 2023.
Hence, we are not inclined to grant bail to the petitioner at this stage.
3. The application for bail is thus rejected.

(Gaurang Kanth, J.) (Joymalya Bagchi, J.)
